what.text: This page follows refugees from China living in India, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 63169 Chinese refugees in India, 41.0% of all refugees from China.
India is the largest host of refugees from China, followed by the United States, France and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records an armed conflict over East Turkestan territory in China with ETIM in 2008.
It also records interstate armed conflicts between China and Vietnam in 1987 to 1988 and between China and India in 2020; the fact pack does not link these to the refugee figures.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1992 at 80000 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 110098, at the end of 2015 and 2016, and was lower by the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in India.
These are year-end totals for India only, reported to UNHCR.
